headline: GOOGLE SIGNS 20-YEAR 3.6GW NUCLEAR DEAL — CONSTELLATION SURGES 12%, URANIUM ETF SPIKES 5% AS AI POWER RACE GOES NUCLEAR
snippet: Google signed a 20-year PPA for 890MW of nuclear power from Constellation Energy — part of a 3.6GW deal triggering $4.3B in new reactor upgrades — sending Constellation up 12% and the VanEck Uranium & Nuclear ETF up 5%. Small-cap uranium names Oklo, NANO Nuclear, and NuScale posted double-digit gains as investors priced in rising baseload power demand from AI hyperscalers.

headline: GOLD ERASES 2026 GAINS AT $4,121 — FED FUTURE HIKE BETS HIT 70%, SILVER DROPS TO 2-MONTH LOW AT $60.57
snippet: Gold fell to $4,121/oz on October 6 — fully erasing its 2026 gains — as market bets on further Federal Reserve rate hikes (beyond October's expected hold) climbed to 70% on the back of strong jobs revisions. Silver tracked lower to $60.57, down 8.4% for the month, with both metals at two-month lows as the September rate hike to 3.75-4% continues to pressure precious metals valuations.

headline: SUN SUMMIT CREEK ZONE: 23.5M AT 4.35 G/T GOLD INCLUDING 4.5M AT 21.80 G/T — FIRST ASSAYS FROM 16,000M BC CAMPAIGN
snippet: Sun Summit Minerals (TSXV: SMN) released first assays from its 2026 Creek Zone drill program at the JD Project in BC's Toodoggone District, with hole CZ-26-023 returning 23.5 metres at 4.35 g/t gold including a high-grade core of 4.5 metres at 21.80 g/t. The company completed its largest-ever single-season program — over 16,000 metres across 55 holes — with the bulk of assays still pending and a maiden resource estimate targeted for Q1 2027.

headline: PROSPECTOR METALS TESS ZONE YUKON: 41.34 G/T GOLD OVER 7.81M — HIGH-GRADE VEIN HIT INCLUDES 130.77 G/T INTERCEPT
snippet: Prospector Metals (TSXV: PPP) extended the high-grade Tess Zone at its fully-funded ML Project in Yukon, with hole ML26-056 returning 41.34 g/t gold over 7.81 metres including 130.77 g/t gold over 2.25 metres. The result advances one of Yukon's emerging high-grade gold stories, with a 25,000-metre three-rig program underway and step-out drilling targeting further vein extensions.

headline: ALPHA EXPLORATION ABURNA: 7M AT 7.09 G/T GOLD IN SECOND RESULT BATCH — EAST AFRICA EXPLORER FIRMS UP HIGH-GRADE ZONE
snippet: Alpha Exploration (TSXV: ALEX) released a second batch of drill results from the Aburna Gold Project, with hole ABD031 intersecting 7 metres at 7.09 g/t gold within a broader 19 metres at 3.18 g/t, and ABD034 returning 6 metres at 3.01 g/t gold within 13 metres at 1.53 g/t. The results continue to define high-grade mineralization and expand the exploration footprint at the East African project.

headline: MP MATERIALS NEARS GM'S FIRST NON-CHINA RARE EARTH MAGNETS — PENTAGON $400M BET REACHES PRODUCTION MILESTONE
snippet: MP Materials (NYSE: MP) is on the verge of delivering General Motors its first batch of rare earth magnets manufactured entirely outside China — the strategic payoff from a $400M Pentagon investment and a new $700M Texas magnet manufacturing campus. MP's revenue surged 89% year-on-year in Q2 2026 to $109M, with the GM shipment marking a milestone in the U.S. effort to build a domestic rare earth-to-magnet supply chain for EV and defense applications.

headline: GOLD MINERS INDEX UP 17.4% IN Q3 — OCTOBER RATE SHOCK RESETS ENTRY POINTS AS BANYAN AND FURY NEAR KEY MILESTONES
snippet: The Gold Miners Index advanced 17.4% in Q3 2026, outpacing gold bullion and the S&P 500 as high margins and exploration catalysts drove re-rating. Junior explorers Banyan Gold Corp and Fury Gold Mines are approaching major milestones on their programs, with sector analysts framing October's pullback — triggered by the Fed's surprise September rate hike — as a reset opportunity rather than a structural reversal.

headline: WHY RECORD 289T CENTRAL BANK GOLD BUYING ISN'T STOPPING MINERS FALLING 2-5X HARDER THAN BULLION
snippet: Despite a record 289 tonnes of central bank gold purchases over the past quarter, gold mining equities are falling two to five times harder than spot gold during October's pullback — with Sibanye Stillwater and Harmony Gold each down nearly 8% in single sessions. The analysis examines how operational leverage amplifies both upswings and downswings, and identifies which producers have balance sheet cushion if gold tests the $4,000 floor.

headline: ANGLO TECK $53B COPPER MERGER AWAITS ONLY CHINA'S SIGN-OFF — SAMR SEEKS SUPPLY PLEDGES, CLOSING WINDOW NARROWING
snippet: The $53 billion Anglo American-Teck merger has cleared six major jurisdictions — the EU, U.S., Canada, Chile, Australia and Japan — with only China's SAMR approval remaining. Chinese regulators are requesting copper supply commitments as a condition, narrowing the closing window to March 2027; the combined Vancouver-headquartered Anglo Teck entity would rank among the world's top-five copper producers.
